targetText:
We shall also learn to do it (again in an unconventional way) with the commission agents, with the buyers working for the state, the petty capitalist co-operators, the entrepreneur concessionaires, etc.

The condition of the masses of workers and peasants needs to be improved right away. And we shall achieve this by putting new forces, including non-Party forces, to useful work. The tax in kind, and a number of measures connected with it, will facilitate this; we shall thereby cut at the economic root of the small producer’s inevitable vacillations.
summary: The proletarian state must learn to utilize capitalist traders, buyers, and concessionaires under strict discipline to improve mass living conditions.
explanation: Just as the Red Army successfully integrated former Tsarist military specialists under political commissars, Soviet economic organs must utilize capitalist merchants and technical experts to revive circulation and improve the material condition of workers and peasants.
